subject: KMS & SSO evidence request — triage and delivery plan
messages:
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medcityhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: KMS ownership and SSO evidence for MedCity contract

Hi Kimberly,

We're getting close to legal review for the MedCity Proof-of-Concept. Legal and InfoSec asked for a short evidence pack:
- KMS key ownership model (BYOK vs Redwood-managed)
- Key rotation cadence and recent rotation log
- SSO configuration screenshots + SAML metadata
- Sample audit logs showing access events (last 90 days)

Can you point me at a single bundle or timeline for delivery? We have an internal deadline of 2026-05-25 to decide on BYOK vs Redwood-managed keys. If certain items require additional approvals, please call them out.

Thanks,
Tom
Procurement Lead, MedCity Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medcityhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-16T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: KMS ownership and SSO evidence for MedCity contract

Tom — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble an evidence pack and flag anything that needs an exception. High-level plan:

1) Neha (Security) will validate and sign off audit samples and SSO config.
2) Marcus (Infra) will prepare key rotation artifacts and confirm whether the requested rotation log is available for POC accounts.
3) Ben (Solutions) will compile screenshots and a short user-facing summary for legal.

Target: initial evidence bundle by Tue 2026-05-19, final by Mon 2026-05-25. If BYOK is required for production we'll include the step-by-step for onboarding keys and an exception request template.

Neha/Marcus/Ben — can you confirm owners and any blockers by end of day?

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-16T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: KMS ownership and SSO evidence for MedCity contract

Assigning technical artifacts to me. Quick notes from infra side:
- We have rotation records for customer-managed keys in our ops DB but export requires an internal job; I can produce a CSV covering the past 6 months.
- For Redwood-managed keys, we publish rotation policy (30/90 day cadence depending on tier) and the KMS provider audit.
- Audit logs: we can produce a redacted JSON sample of access events (I will scrub IPs and user emails). See attached draft: medcity_kms_key_rotation_plan.xlsx will include timelines and required approvals for BYOK onboarding.

Blockers: if the customer wants HSM-backed BYOK with dedicated HSM and dedicated network, that'll require Private deployment engagement (longer lead time). Otherwise POC BYOK on Dedicated pools is feasible within 2–3 weeks.

I'll get the rotation CSV and an audit-log sample by 2026-05-18 EOD.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: KMS ownership and SSO evidence for MedCity contract

Thanks — pulled together a short checklist for the pack:

Required artifacts (security sign-off):
- KMS key policy doc (who can perform rotation/disable) — Marcus to provide.
- Rotation evidence (time-stamped entries) — Marcus to provide redacted CSV.
- Audit log sample (read/write/admin events) — Marcus to provide sample JSON; we will redact PII.
- SSO metadata and IdP config screenshots — Ben to compile.
- Data retention policy (how long logs are retained and export process) — I will provide an excerpt from the retention playbook.

Exceptions/questions:
- Retention window: default is 90 days for hosted logs, expandable for Dedicated/Private with extra cost. Need to confirm MedCity target retention.
- BYOK: if customer requires external HSM or separate KMS tenancy, Legal/Compliance must sign an exception (Rishi).

Action owners: Marcus (rotation + audit sample) / Ben (SSO screenshots + narrative) / Neha (retention excerpt + security review) / Rishi (exception template).

I'll perform a quick validation once we have the bundle. If anything in the audit sample looks anomalous I'll flag it with the incident ops team.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: KMS ownership and SSO evidence for MedCity contract

Acknowledged. For legal/compliance: recommended customer-facing language and next steps below that Kimberly can forward to MedCity.

Suggested customer language (short):
"Redwood Inference supports both Redwood-managed and customer-managed (BYOK) key models. For production deployments requiring hardware-backed keys or isolated KMS tenancy, we recommend our Private deployment option. We can provide rotation logs and redacted audit samples for evaluation. Any exceptions to standard retention or access controls require formal approval and a short exceptions addendum."

Next steps for us:
- I'll prepare a one-page exceptions template for BYOK/HSM that outlines required covenants and timelines — delivery 2026-05-18.
- Legal will need to review wording if MedCity requires HSM-backed keys.

If Ben or Marcus find anything that increases compliance risk (PII in logs, unexpected admin activity), escalate to me immediately.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medcityhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lara Chen <lara.chen@acme-security.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: KMS ownership and SSO evidence for MedCity contract — initial bundle attached

Tom — delivering the initial evidence bundle and next steps below. Attached: evidence-index-v1.pdf (index), medcity_kms_key_rotation_plan.xlsx (rotation summary), audit-log-sample-2026-05.json (redacted sample).

Summary / next steps:
- We attached the redacted audit sample and a rotation plan summary. Marcus confirmed rotations are available as CSV exports; we'll include a CSV if you need raw timestamps.
- Neha attached retention guidance: default hosted log retention is 90 days; Dedicated/Private options available for longer retention. Please confirm target retention.
- Rishi will prepare a BYOK/HSM exceptions template if you decide that production requires HSM-backed keys.

Action items for MedCity:
1) Confirm whether BYOK with HSM is required for production (if yes, we will start the exceptions/Private deployment discussion).
2) Confirm retention requirement (e.g., 180 days) or accept default 90 days.

Internal notes: Ben will follow up with screenshots for SSO metadata; Marcus to drop the rotation CSV into the Drive folder; Neha/Rishi to finalize the exception template by 2026-05-18 EOD.

Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-index-v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB), medcity_kms_key_rotation_plan.xlsx (XLSX, 35KB), audit-log-sample-2026-05.json (JSON, 450KB)
